name: Sofia Vargas Trujillo
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying engineering at the National University of Colombia, she became fascinated by the data analysis aspect of racing, seeing it as a complex puzzle to solve. She started volunteering for local racing teams, quickly demonstrating a knack for identifying crucial performance gains through innovative strategies.

Her approach to strategy is meticulous and data-driven, yet always open to intuitive leaps. She believes in empowering her team to take calculated risks, fostering a culture of innovation. What sets Sofia apart is her ability to see the bigger picture, anticipating not just the immediate race situation but also the long-term championship implications. Her loyalty to Full Time Sports is unwavering, stemming from a shared vision for success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A focused woman with an intense gaze, she exudes quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing data and handwritten notes.
Has a habit of pacing during crucial race moments.
Prefers to communicate via concise, data-backed memos rather than long meetings.
